# PocketBI GitHub Discoverability Notes

This file records the public-facing GitHub metadata recommended for this repository. It contains no private implementation details.

## Recommended repository description

PocketBI — practical data analytics and business intelligence tools for CSV/Excel cleaning, SQL/Python/R analysis, visualization, reconciliation, and repeatable workflows.

## Recommended website

https://pocketbi.app

## Naming

Preferred repository name, if renamed later: `PocketBI` or `PocketBI-Public`.

Keep product naming consistent as **PocketBI** in titles and prose. Historical internal repository names should not be used as the public product name.

## Search language

Use important search terms naturally in public documentation rather than keyword stuffing. Useful phrases include:

- data analytics
- business intelligence
- CSV and Excel cleaning
- data quality
- SQL analysis
- Python and R analysis
- data visualization
- file reconciliation
- repeatable data workflows
- browser IDE
- iPhone data tools

## Public/private boundary

Discoverability must never come at the cost of exposing credentials, private endpoints, infrastructure topology, private schemas, customer data, internal release identifiers, or proprietary source code.
